reproduction.run_counts_sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
ART=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
source "$ART/../rust-dev/activate.sh"
T="$ART/../rust-dev/llvm-tools-rust-1.96/llvm-tools-preview/lib/rustlib/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin"
cohort=${1:?cohort}
BIN=$(python3 - "$ART/$cohort-build.jsonl" <<'PY'
import json,sys
xs=[j['executable'] for l in open(sys.argv[1]) if (j:=json.loads(l)).get('reason')=='compiler-artifact' and j.get('target',{}).get('name')=='lang_codegen' and j.get('executable')]
assert len(xs)==1,xs
print(xs[0])
PY
)
cp "$BIN" "$ART/bin/$cohort"
"$T/llvm-nm" --defined-only --format=posix "$BIN" > "$ART/$cohort-mangled.txt"
"$T/llvm-nm" --defined-only --format=posix --demangle "$BIN" > "$ART/$cohort-demangled.txt"
modes='setup index lower emit'
if test "$cohort" = after; then modes='setup index lower emit factory viewlower viewemit'; fi
for fixture in small representative; do
 for mode in $modes; do
  name="$cohort-$fixture-$mode"
  test ! -e "$ART/profiles/$name.profraw"
  LLVM_PROFILE_FILE="$ART/profiles/$name.profraw" P3A_FIXTURE="$ART/fixtures/$fixture" P3A_MODE="$mode" P3A_OUTPUT="$ART/objects/$fixture-$cohort-$mode.o" "$BIN" const_index_probe::const_index_probe --exact --nocapture > "$ART/profiles/$name.stdout" 2> "$ART/profiles/$name.stderr"
  "$T/llvm-profdata" merge -sparse "$ART/profiles/$name.profraw" -o "$ART/profiles/$name.profdata"
  "$T/llvm-cov" export "$BIN" -instr-profile="$ART/profiles/$name.profdata" > "$ART/profiles/$name.json"
 done
done
reproduction.build: source rust-dev/activate.sh; LLVM_PROFILE_FILE=<artifact>/build-profiles/<cohort>-%p-%m.profraw RUSTFLAGS="-C instrument-coverage" CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<isolated-coverage-target> cargo test --manifest-path <worktree>/Cargo.toml --locked --offline -p lang-codegen --lib --no-run --message-format=json > <artifact>/<cohort>-build.jsonl 2> <artifact>/<cohort>-build.stderr
reproduction.note: Scripts record actual workspace root. Reproduction requires changing that root and creating fixture bytes from the manifest; profile artifacts were not committed.
